The draft plan places the center in the Library Annex on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with space for up to 24 students, staffed by one teacher assisted by volunteers. I'd like to hear from each of you -- the teacher, the librarian, and the human-resources coordinator -- on the operational details so we can make sure this plan is solid. Please share any findings or concerns you've verified.
